## Summary

Describe the resulting behavior or documentation improvement.

## Why

Explain the problem this change solves.

## What changed

List the focused changes and any relevant limitations.

## Testing

Record commands and actual results. If a check does not apply, explain why.

## Screenshots

For visible changes, include relevant before/after views using synthetic data.
Remove private documents, user information and local paths. Otherwise mark N/A.

## Checklist

- [ ] Change is focused and has a clear purpose.
- [ ] Tests are updated where behavior changes, or not applicable with an explanation.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or private material are included.
- [ ] Required licenses, notices and attribution are preserved.
- [ ] No unrelated formatting churn is included.
